articles.title: Two Planes Collide on the Ground in Miami; Only Minor Injuries Reported
articles.summary: A Copa Airlines plane's wingtip struck a UPS cargo plane's nose at a Miami airport intersection on Saturday night; two people had minor injuries.

articles.title: When Food Aid Shrinks, a San Diego Office Doubles as a Food Pantry
articles.summary: In San Diego, a social services office now hands out free groceries as about five million people nationwide have lost SNAP food benefits.

articles.title: Canada Pledges $560 Million to Brazil-Led Fund to Protect Rainforests
articles.summary: Canada will give up to $560 million over four years to a Brazil- and Norway-led fund that pays countries to protect tropical rainforests.
